proposals.before: In the fourth year he usurped the emperor's title at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, set a traveling temple south of the palace, and sent envoys with the document to report completion.
proposals.after: In the fourth year he claimed the imperial throne at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, established a temporary ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys bearing a document to report the accomplishment.
proposals.reason: 行廟 is a temporary ancestral temple; 僭 conveys the history’s disapproval, not an objective judgment. 奉策告成 is a report of an accomplishment bearing a document: its precise contents, recipient and nature of the accomplishment remain unspecified.

proposals.before: In Long'an 4 (AD 400), he claimed the imperial title at the southern suburban altar, issued a general amnesty, inaugurated the Jianping era, established a traveling ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys bearing the accession proclamation.
proposals.after: In Long'an 4 (AD 400), he claimed the imperial throne at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, adopted the Jianping era name, established a temporary ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys with a document to report the accomplishment.
proposals.reason: Restore the reporting act in 告成 without specifying the document, recipient, or accomplishment more narrowly than the source. Temporary ancestral temple is a contextual rendering of 行廟. The retained Long’an 4 / AD 400 contextual date needs independent date review.

decisions.after: In the fourth year, at the southern suburb he assumed the imperial throne—an act the history presents as usurpation—issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, established a temporary ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys bearing a document to report the accomplishment there.
decisions.reason: Revise to restore the locative 焉, read as the immediately preceding temporary temple; this antecedent is plausible but interpretative. Attribute the evaluative 僭 to the history, not objective fact. Keep the document and reported accomplishment unspecified. The AD conversion in the idiomatic field remains unaudited.

sourceWitness.citation: Jinshu 127, s0177, sealed dossier; cf. Tongdian juan 47, imperial ancestral temple rites
sourceWitness.excerpt: 四年，僭即皇帝位於南郊，大赦，改元為建平，設行廟于宮南，遣使奉策告成焉。
